profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Ford
profile.summary: During my two internships I've gained experience with creating and maintaining APIs. As well as the frontends that consume data from those APIs. While at Oakland University I independently and collaboratively worked on applications geared towards student success. While at DigitalOcean I worked on delivering a backend service to help the company improve troubleshooting customer network issues with an accompanying frontend for the support team to use. During my internships I've worked with technologies such as Spring, React, Redux, Go, Docker, CI and much more.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
- Independently designed as well as collaborated on full stack applications
- Worked with technologies such as Java, React / Redux, Spring, Docker, Go, Git, Gradle, Gitlab-CI, and many more
- Maintained applications with 20,000 users
- Assisted with on-boarding new student developers to team

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed full stack application to assist the network team with troubleshooting customer network issues as well as the support team
- Participated in a agile and test driven development environment 
- Used Kubernetes to deploy both the Go and React projects

positions.title: Student Tutor
positions.description: Greeting students. Speaking with the student and identifying their problem and why they are having that problem. Secondly, depending on the student either provide a leading or supplementary role on solving the problem. Finally, reviewing the problem, the possible solutions, and general ways to solve problems in the future.

honors.title: OU Distinguished Transfer Award
honors.description: Awarded to new transfer students with a college GPA of 3.60 or greater and 24 or more transferable credits. Note that the 24 transferable credits must be earned by the scholarship deadline.

honors.title: OU Non-Resident Transfer Award
honors.description: Awarded to transfer students with a college GPA of a 3.0 or higher, 24 or more transferable credits who are not Michigan residents and allows them to pay in-state tuition rates.  Citizens of Canada and Mexico also qualify. Note that 24 transferable credits must be earned by the scholarship deadline.

projects.title: SpartaHack
projects.description: Schoolmates and I teamed up at Michigan State University to participate in the first Hackathon at Michigan State.
